licence.title: Physician Assistant (PA) licence
licence.renewalDeadline: Annually, on or before the last day of the licensee's birth month; no grace period

ce.categoryRules: 20 credit hours of continuing medical education per year; the rule names no Category 1 minimum and no AAPA category split for PAs

topicMandates.period: not stated in rule (rule says 'must complete at least five'; read as a standing condition of the hydrocodone authority)
topicMandates.appliesTo: PAs authorized to prescribe Schedule II hydrocodone combination products

ce.controlledSubstanceCe: 1 hour per year on prescribing opioids and benzodiazepines (all PAs); 5 hours pain management for PAs authorized for Schedule II hydrocodone combination products

practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Delegation agreement (board form) must be accepted by the board before licensure; the written supervision agreement must be signed by physician and PA and updated annually; a copy is kept at the practice location; changes or additions of supervising physicians are reported to the board within 10 calendar days
practice.notes: Statute defines the PA as a dependent professional working under physician supervision and a delegation agreement. Schedule II limited to opioids for 5 days or less and stimulants initiated by a physician who saw the patient within 6 months, plus hydrocodone combination products if delegated.

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: No separate state certificate; prescriptive authority (legend and Schedule II to V) is delegated in the delegation agreement and the request is approved by the board. DEA registration required to prescribe controlled substances.
prescribing.ceForPrescribers: 1 hour per year opioids and benzodiazepines; 5 hours pain management if authorized for Schedule II hydrocodone combination products

facts.value: 20 credit hours per year
facts.quote: shall complete twenty (20) credit hours per year of continuing medical education.

facts.value: 1 hour per year, included in the 20
facts.quote: Each year, each physician assistant shall obtain at least one (1) hour of CME credit specifically regarding the prescribing of opioids and benzodiazepines.

facts.value: 5 hours pain management for PAs authorized to prescribe Schedule II hydrocodone combination products
facts.quote: must complete at least five (5) continuing education hours in the area of pain management.
facts.note: Rule states no period (annual vs one-time); period unconfirmed.

facts.value: Keep CME records at least 3 years from end of reporting period; random audit possible
facts.quote: must be maintained by the licensee for at least three (3) years from the end of the reporting period.

facts.value: Annual renewal by last day of birth month, no grace period
facts.cite: ASMB PA application packet (Rev. 4/28/2026), License Renewal
facts.quote: must be renewed annually on or before the last day of your birth month. There is no grace period.

facts.value: Written agreement signed by physician and PA, updated annually
facts.quote: The agreement shall be signed by the physician and the physician assistant and updated annually.

facts.value: Board must accept the delegation agreement before licensure; copy kept at practice location
facts.quote: Said delegation agreement must be accepted by the board prior to licensure of the physician assistant.

facts.value: Report changes in supervising physicians within 10 calendar days
facts.quote: A physician assistant shall notify the Arkansas State Medical Board of any changes or additions in supervising physicians within ten (10) calendar days.

facts.value: Prescribing authority stated in the delegation agreement and approved by the board
facts.quote: Said authorization must be stated in the delegation agreement and the request approved by the Arkansas State Medical Board.

facts.value: PAs who prescribe controlled substances register with DEA (mid-level practitioner)
facts.quote: Physician assistants who prescribe controlled substances shall register with the United States Drug Enforcement Administration

facts.value: Schedule II only for opioids 5 days or less, or stimulants initiated by a physician who saw the patient within 6 months
facts.quote: An opioid, if the prescription is only for a five-day period or less

facts.value: NCCPA is an initial licensure condition only (pass PANCE); the renewal statute lists fee, forms and board requirements, and no rule requires current NCCPA at renewal
facts.quote: has passed the Physician Assistant National Certifying Examination administered by the National Commission on Certification of Physician Assistants

facts.value: 17 CAR 140-1809 is current (Code of Arkansas Rules page updated 10/1/2026); the board's pending Subpart 18 rulemaking (markup PDF Feb 2026) leaves 140-1809 unchanged
facts.cite: 17 CAR 140-1809; ASMB proposed rulemaking markup, 17 CAR pt.140 subpt.18
facts.quote: A physician assistant who holds an active license to practice in the State of Arkansas shall complete twenty (20) credit hours per year

rn.ceAlternatives: One per renewal period: 15 practice-focused contact hours, OR national certification or recertification during the renewal period, OR an academic course in nursing or a related field (board page: at least one college credit hour, grade C or better)
rn.renewalDeadline: Staggered biennial birth date system; exact expiry day (for example last day of birth month) not confirmed in a primary source

aprn.title: APRN (Certified Nurse Practitioner role, with population focus)
aprn.separateLicenceOrCertificate: Separate APRN licence; separate Certificate of Prescriptive Authority; optional Full Independent Practice Authority certificate
aprn.ceHoursPerCycle: No separate APRN hour count; CE submitted to the national certifying body for recertification is accepted as meeting the statutory requirement

topicMandates.topic: Maintaining professional boundaries, and Arkansas APRN prescribing rules and laws
topicMandates.appliesTo: APRNs with prescriptive authority (2 of the 5 pharmacotherapeutics hours)

prescribing.separateAuthorityRegistration: Certificate of Prescriptive Authority from ASBN (3 graduate credit hour or 45 contact hour pharmacology course, 300 hour prescribing preceptorship, collaborative practice agreement unless full practice authority)
prescribing.pharmacologyCeForPrescribers: 5 contact hours pharmacotherapeutics in the area of certification each biennium before renewal
prescribing.controlledSubstanceCe: 2 of the 5 hours on professional boundaries and Arkansas prescribing rules and laws; no separate controlled substance hour mandate found

practice.agreementType: collaborative practice agreement (for prescriptive authority) unless granted full independent practice authority
practice.agreementFilingAndRenewal: Collaborative practice agreement submitted with the prescriptive authority application; evidence of a current agreement is a prerequisite to every APRN renewal for prescribers without full practice authority; notify board within 7 days of termination; protocols reviewed at least annually; full independent practice authority certificate renews every 3 years

facts.value: Biennial
facts.quote: Each person licensed under the provisions of the Nurse Practice Act shall renew biennially.

facts.value: 15 practice-focused contact hours, or certification/recertification, or an academic course, each renewal period
facts.quote: Fifteen (15) practice-focused contact hours from a nationally recognized or state continuing education approval body recognized by the Arkansas State Board of Nursing

facts.value: Yes, implemented January 19, 2018; APRNs are not licensed under the NLC
facts.cite: ASBN Compact page (read via WebFetch; curl 403)
facts.quote: The official implementation date for the new NLC was January 19, 2018.

facts.value: APRN renewal coincides with RN renewal; requires current national certification
facts.quote: Documentation of current national certification in the appropriate APRN specialty through a maintenance program of a board-approved certifying body

facts.value: Certifying body recertification CE accepted as meeting the statutory CE requirement
facts.quote: Continuing education submitted to the certifying body to meet the qualifications for recertification shall be accepted as meeting the statutory requirement

facts.value: 5 contact hours pharmacotherapeutics each biennium for prescribers
facts.quote: APRNs with prescriptive authority shall complete five (5) contact hours of pharmacotherapeutics continuing education in the APRN's area of certification each biennium

facts.value: 2 of the 5 hours: professional boundaries and Arkansas APRN prescribing rules and laws
facts.quote: Two (2) of the five (5) hours must contain information related to: (A) Maintaining professional boundaries

facts.value: Current collaborative practice agreement is a prerequisite to renewal for prescribers without full practice authority
facts.quote: shall submit evidence of a current collaborative practice agreement as a prerequisite to license renewal.

facts.value: Full independent practice authority certificate renews every 3 years
facts.quote: shall apply for renewal of the full independent practice authority certificate every three (3) years.

facts.value: 6,240 hours of practice under a board-required physician agreement (or prescribing in another state) to qualify for full independent practice authority
facts.cite: 17 CAR § 123-702(a)(3) (ASBN Part 123 final rule PDF dated 07/21/2026)
facts.quote: Completed a minimum of six thousand two hundred forty (6,240) hours of practice

facts.value: Initial prescriptive authority requires pharmacology course, 300 hour preceptorship and a collaborative practice agreement unless exempt
facts.quote: a minimum of three hundred (300) clock hours preceptorial experience in the prescription of drugs, medicines, and therapeutic devices

facts.value: Inactive prescriptive authority: extra 5 pharmacotherapeutics hours per 12 months not prescribing, plus the 5 renewal hours
facts.quote: for each twelve (12) months of nonprescribing activity in addition to the five (5) contact hours required for APRN license renewal

facts.value: Notify board in writing within 7 days after a collaborative practice agreement ends
facts.quote: shall notify the board in writing within seven (7) days following termination of the collaborative practice agreement.

facts.value: Staggered biennial birth date system; first licence valid 3 to 27 months
facts.cite: ASBN Renewal of Arkansas License page (read via WebFetch; curl 403)
facts.quote: The ASBN renews licenses on a staggered biennial birth date system.

facts.value: Board CE page: 15 contact hours OR current national certification OR one college credit hour course (C or better); APRN prescribers add 5 pharmacotherapeutics hours each renewal
facts.cite: ASBN Continuing Education page (read via WebFetch; curl 403)
facts.quote: advanced practice registered nurses with prescriptive authority must complete an additional five contact hours of pharmacotherapeutics

facts.value: 17 CAR 123-207 text is identical in the ASBN Part 123 final rule PDF stamped 07/21/2026
facts.quote: APRNs with prescriptive authority shall complete five (5) contact hours of pharmacotherapeutics continuing education in the APRN's area of certification each biennium

facts.value: Prescriptive authority lapses if the APRN licence is not renewed, national certification expires, or no current collaborative practice agreement (if required) is on file
facts.quote: The national certification upon which licensure is based expires

facts.value: Prescribing protocols required under a collaborative practice agreement; reviewed at least annually
facts.quote: Date the protocol was adopted or last reviewed, which shall be at least annually.

facts.value: APRN files DEA registration number with ASBN on receipt
facts.quote: The APRN shall file his or her Drug Enforcement Administration registration number with the Arkansas State Board of Nursing upon receipt

facts.value: Except hydrocodone combination products, Schedule II opioids limited to 5 days; Schedule II stimulants only if physician initiated and saw patient within 6 months
facts.quote: the APRN shall not prescribe Schedule II opioids for more than a five-day period.

unverified: PA and NP state controlled substance registration: no Arkansas state CS registration requirement appears in 17 CAR 140 Subpart 18, Ark. Code 17-105, or ASBN Part 123 (only DEA, and for APRNs filing the DEA number with ASBN). Absence only; left null.
PA NCCPA at renewal: false rests on absence (17-105-105 and 140-1809 say nothing); no source says it explicitly.
PA 5-hour pain management (17 CAR 140-1809(f)) for hydrocodone combination prescribers: period (annual vs one-time) not stated in the rule.
RN expiry day: ASBN says staggered biennial birth date system; the exact day (secondary sources say last day of birth month) was not found in a primary source.
ASBN pages on healthy.arkansas.gov return 403 to curl; renewal, CE and compact pages were read through WebFetch only.

Practice authority label 'reduced' is our reading of 17 CAR 123-207(c), 123-601(5) and 123-702 (collaborative practice agreement required for prescriptive authority until 6,240 hours and a full independent practice certificate).

corrections: pa.licence.renewalDeadline cite: PA application packet revision is Rev. 4/28/2026, not 6/12/2026 (text and quote unchanged).
Added np.rn.renewalDeadline (staggered biennial birth date system) from the ASBN renewal page; exact expiry day still unconfirmed.
np.rn.ceAlternatives: board page specifies the academic option as at least one college credit hour with grade C or better; pharmacotherapeutics hours are in addition to the RN option.
np.rn.nlcCompactMember cite corrected to say the ASBN compact page was read via WebFetch (curl blocked).

Added facts: 123-207 unchanged in the 07/21/2026 Part 123 final rule; prescriptive authority lapses if national certification expires or the CPA is missing (123-608); protocols reviewed at least annually (123-603); DEA number filed with ASBN (123-604(c)(10)); Schedule II limits (123-604(c)(7)-(8)).
Added PA facts: NCCPA only an initial licensure condition (17-105-102(b)(3), 17-105-105); 140-1809 current and unchanged by the pending Feb 2026 Subpart 18 rulemaking.

Missed-mandate sweep (opioid, implicit bias, human trafficking, child abuse, ethics, HIV, end of life, dementia, suicide, infection control, cultural competency, domestic violence): none found for AR PAs beyond the 1-hour opioid/benzodiazepine and 5-hour pain management rules, or for AR APRNs beyond the 2 professional boundaries/prescribing law hours. 17 CAR 140-1810 requires PAs to follow the HIV/HBV/HCV rule (practice standard, not CE).
